name: Reaching a level offers the Hero's Call or Warchief's Command zone orders it unlocks as a pop-up
contract: The Ascension client shows a "Quest Discovered!" pop-up for SMSG 0x927 {quest, 0} (OFFER) and accepts it with CMSG_QUESTGIVER_ACCEPT_QUEST carrying no quest giver. Reaching a level offers every zone order of the faction whose minimum level was just reached: the fixture's level-up from 1 to 19 offers the three level 10 orders 14204, 14212 and 14220, and reaching 20 offers Hero's Call: Redridge Mountains! 14209 and Hero's Call: Duskwood! 14208, not the level 10 orders again nor the Horde order 14243; a Horde character reaching 10 is offered Warchief's Command: The Barrens! 14232, not the level 15 order 14233. Accepting the pop-up adds the order to the quest log; an order above the character's level is refused. The client does not report a dismissed pop-up, so each order is offered only on the level-up that unlocks it: logging in again at 20 offers neither the dismissed 14208 and 14222, nor the level 10 orders, nor the accepted 14209 (#7536).
